why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Quip Points site Go to the Quip Points site , which shows the campaign as live, and sign in to see your points and the leaderboard.

2 Step 2 : Link an X account and follow @quipnetwork The Quip wallet's parent wallet must be linked to an X account, and that account must follow @quipnetwork. Both are listed as prerequisites for every earning route.
3 Step 3 : Sign in to your Quip account daily Sign in at the Quip account app . Each sign-in earns 1 QP, up to 5 QP a day.

4 Step 4 : Swap on QuipSwap Trade on the order book at QuipSwap . Each swap earns 5 points when the traded value is above $0.01 and the swap settles on chain, up to 15 swaps a day. Points can take up to 1 hour to appear.
5 Step 5 : Run a node Set up a testnet node using the node guide . Points are paid for qblocks mined and blocks won, up to 2,000 QP a week plus 20 points per qblock won.
6 Step 6 : Refer new users Take your referral link from the Quip Points site . You earn points for each person who joins through it and creates an account.
